LESSON: HADITH OF PROPHET MUHAMMAD AS A MODEL OF GOOD CHARACTER.

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the character traits of a good child?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on the character of the Prophet as a role model
2. value the Prophet as a role model by practising his character traits in daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH OF PROPHET MUHAMMAD AS A MODEL OF GOOD CHARACTER.
This lesson teaches Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. for Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the selected hadith on the character of the Prophet as a role model
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. value the Prophet as a role model by practising his character traits in daily life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. above.
2. Explain Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the character traits of a good child?
2. What were the character traits of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) as a youth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected hadith on the character of the Prophet as a role model
2. value the Prophet as a role model by practising his character traits in daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
